quarterly_data.quarter: Delton Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 mix and regions (half-year report): server PCBs were about 90% of revenue. Revenue RMB 4,388,260,234.74 (+80.98%), which the company attributes to strong demand from computing-power customers with both volumes and prices rising; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 939,402,064.37 (+96.71%). Overseas sales RMB 3,170,757,036.33, up 97.26%, 72.26% of revenue, gross margin 41.62%; domestic sales RMB 916,182,250.00, up 39.27%, gross margin 13.70%. R&D spending RMB 230,105,083.90, up 96.64%. Export sales were about 80% of main-business revenue.
quarterly_data.figure: server PCBs about 90% of revenue; overseas sales RMB 3,170,757,036.33 (+97.26%, GM 41.62%); R&D +96.64%

quarterly_data.quarter: Delton Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Yunqing Smart Manufacturing Base (half-year report): construction is progressing well and the project is expected to start production at the end of November 2026, laying the capacity base for taking high-end GPU products in 2027. Positioned for AI computing, it is planned to produce samples of up to 100 layers and to mass-produce 18- to 78-layer ultra-high-multilayer PCBs and 5- to 7-step HDI, with mSAP process; budget RMB 2,558,680,000.00, 11.97% complete at June 30, 2026. The company has begun preparing Yunqing phase II.
quarterly_data.figure: production start expected end of November 2026; 18-78 layer PCBs and 5-7 step HDI; budget RMB 2,558,680,000.00

quarterly_data.quarter: Delton Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity (half-year report): a new round of retrofits at the Guangzhou plant, the main manufacturing base, is expected to release new capacity in H2 2026 to meet growing customer demand and ease the current capacity tightness. The Thailand plant is 100% focused on high-end computing-server motherboards and earned strong profits at high utilisation and yield; it expects new capacity in Q4 2026. The Thailand subsidiary posted H1 2026 revenue RMB 48,085.24 ten-thousand and net profit RMB 16,530.17 ten-thousand. The Thailand project budget is RMB 1,637,500,000.00 (73.06% complete); the Huangshi raised-fund multilayer PCB project (phase I, stage 2) is due to reach usable state on April 1, 2027 (82.66% invested). Construction in progress rose to RMB 844,673,127.08 from RMB 254,595,042.78 on the Guangzhou and Thailand expansions.
quarterly_data.figure: Guangzhou new capacity H2 2026; Thailand H1 net profit RMB 16,530.17 ten-thousand; Thailand project budget RMB 1,637,500,000.00
